The Truto Unified CRM API provides a single normalized interface for reading and writing CRM data across 27 CRM providers including Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Attio, Outreach, Wealthbox, Teamleader, and more. Offers 17 unified resources covering the full CRM data model. Data is accessed in real-time via pass-through. Schema can be extended using JSONata mappings without code deploys.
